title: The Oasis
tagline: AI-Directed Decentralized Movies (Crowd-Owned Film Studio). Welcome to AI-Directed Decentralized Movies, a revolutionary platform that combines AI creativity, blockchain transparency, and community-driven storytelling to create crowd-owned films.
description: Imagine a world where Hollywood , Bollywood is no longer a gatekeeper, and anyone can be a filmmaker, producer, or even a virtual actor. Welcome to AI-Directed Decentralized Movies, a revolutionary platform that combines AI creativity, blockchain transparency, and community-driven storytelling to create crowd-owned films. This is not just a film studio—it’s a decentralized entertainment ecosystem where YOU decide what gets made, how it’s made, and who profits from it.
how_its_made: This is a AI based movie studio. First DAOs will be created of each movie and the movie DAO creator will get Founder NFTs and then contributors joins and for scripts and video voting will be done . The users who will finalize the steps will receive tokens as rewards and at last the revenue will be distributed according to number and the value of tokens each contributor have . We have use CDP agentkit for sending nfts tokens to the contributors liek scriptNFTs , and revenue distribution . We have used IPFS storage with Pinata . We have used Gemini for ai generations .
